text: The rights for new Olim (including those who converted in Israel) depend on how long the Oleh/Olah has lived in Israel before having their Aliyah approved :) The most significant benefits (including the sal klita absorption basket, which includes the rental and living assistance) are only available to those who have lived less than 24 months in Israel in the past 3 years. After this, the benefits are greatly reduced and may even be nothing. Unfortunately, this means most converts don't get much, if anything
